scope: exact candidate validation, ordered Git integration, and authorized offline Gates
failure_boundaries: dirty or ownership-violating candidates fail closed
candidate, plan, report, evidence, and receipt identities are revalidated before mutation
integration follows manifest order in the declared integrator workspace
Git mutation and Gate commands require separate explicit flags
Gate execution stops on the first nonzero command
known_limits: No live Codex handoff or message was consumed.
No push, sealed evaluator, submodule, LFS, or long integration queue was tested.
No comparative automation benefit has been established.
